home.title: FriRSS — a modern frontend for FreshRSS
home.description: A modern, self-hosted FreshRSS frontend. Read on desktop or mobile, customize your themes and explore optional AI summaries. Your FriRSS, your rules.

features.title: Features | FriRSS
features.description: Explore FriRSS: grid and three-pane reading, an offline RSS reader PWA, custom themes, optional AI translation, OIDC and multiple FreshRSS servers.
